body:
Plan A OK'd (31 Oct), now built (book v145), Model Compare → Pet Show:
1) Podium: 3 blue steps, 1st in the middle (0.9 high, gold 1), 2nd left (silver 2), 3rd right (bronze 3), white tops, paw on step 1. 3.9 x 1.0 x 1.6 units.
2) Stage for Sir Barkley behind it: low wooden stage with steps, blue back panel, gold Pet Show banner, paw signs, two ribbon rosettes, bunting, flower pots. 4.7 x 3.5 x 4.4 with the podium.
3) License card in the hand: 0.36 x 0.24 units, vintage paper card like the Screens card: shield with a paw, ANIMAL LICENSE, your name, level stars, Certified stamp (gold TOP LEVEL at level 3), Signed: Sir Barkley. Levels 1-3.
Reviewer: podium 7.5, stage 8, card 9/10.
Pick in Model Compare → Pet Show (🔔).

comments.text: Thanks. All 3 are marked picked: podium, stage, license card. You said the podium must not block the stage, so I built the whole area in the park as a new card: Model Compare → Pet Show → Pet Show area. The podium now stands beside the stage, and the judges' table sits at the other front corner.

short: OK'd: podium, stage and license card. The layout is in the new card Pet Show area
title: Pet Show podium + license card
